# sonarqube_project (Resource)

A SonarQube project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_project" "api" {
  name       = "API"
  project    = "example-api"
  visibility = "private"
  tags       = ["backend", "payments"]

  # When any setting block is present, the list is authoritative.
  setting {
    key    = "sonar.exclusions"
    values = ["**/generated/**", "**/vendor/**"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. SonarQube has no API to rename a project, so changing it is refused at plan time instead of destroying the project and its analysis history. If analyses set the name through `sonar.projectName`, add `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [name] }`; to recreate the project deliberately, use `terraform apply -replace`.
- `project` (String) Project key. Changing it renames the key in place and keeps the project's history.

### Optional

- `contains_ai_code` (Boolean) Whether the project contains AI-generated code, which lets AI Code Assurance quality gates apply to it. Requires the Developer edition or above. When omitted, the flag is not managed.
- `retrieve_badge_token` (Boolean) Read the project's badge token into `badge_token`. Set to `false` to keep it out of state.
- `setting` (Block List) Settings of the component. When at least one block is present, the list is authoritative: settings set on the component but not listed here are reset to their inherited value. When no block is present, component settings are not managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--setting))
- `tags` (Set of String) Project tags. When omitted, tags are not managed; set `[]` to remove all tags.
- `visibility` (String) `public` or `private`. When omitted, the server's default project visibility applies (the previous provider forced `public`, which could expose code on private-by-default servers).

### Read-Only

- `badge_token` (String) Badge token of the project.
- `id` (String) The project key.

<a id="nestedblock--setting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `setting`

Required:

- `key` (String) Setting key.

Optional:

- `field_values` (List of Map of String) Field values of a property-set setting.
- `value` (String) Value of a single-value setting.
- `values` (List of String) Values of a multi-value setting.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = sonarqube_project.example
  identity = { key = "example-api" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `key` (String) Project key.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_project.example 'example-api'
```
